guidetextdraw_244701._value:
Definition of parent: For the FAFSA, “parent” refers to your biological and/ or adoptive parents (including your step-parent If that person is currently married to your “parent”). The following are NOT considered to be a “legal parent” for the FAFSA:

  • Grandparents, foster parents, legal guardians, aunts and uncles are NOT considered parents unless they have legally adopted you.
  • Any person who is not married to your parent and who is not a legal or biological parent

If your parent’s FAFSA marital status is “married,” or “unmarried and both parents living together,” then both their information must be provided.
guidetextdraw_244701.name: DefinitionOfParent

guidetextdraw._value:
Why are my parents being asked to submit this form?

They may need to file an amended 1040, which is very common and may be required for a variety of reasons. Some of the most common reasons for needing to file an amended tax return are:

  • To report your proper tax filing status because one or both married individuals filed as head-of-household when they appear not to meet the eligibility requirements.
  • To remove a dependent you previously claimed because that dependent claimed himself or herself on their own tax return.

Another reason for this form is that the IRS made minor internal corrections while processing the tax return, on their behalf, and documentation of that is needed.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1656671602572

guidetextdraw_copy._value:
ACTION TO COMPLETE FORM:

Please select #1 or #2 and submit the required documents below.

1. Your parents filed an amended tax return, provide the following:
guidetextdraw_copy.name: ActionToCompleteForm

guidetextdraw_119177._value: A copy of your parent’s original 2019 IRS Tax Return Transcript or 2019 1040 Tax Returns
guidetextdraw_119177.name: Website

guidetextdraw._value: A signed copy of your parent’s 2019 IRS Form 1040X “Amended U.S. Individual Income Tax Return”
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1656674141426

guidetextdraw_1270925513._value: 2. Your parents DID NOT file an amended tax return, but the IRS made minor internal corrections while processing the tax return, provide the following:
guidetextdraw_1270925513.name: textdraw_12709255131656674196682

guidetextdraw_179168._value: A copy of your parent’s original 2019 IRS Tax Return Transcript OR Unchanged IRS Data Retrieval Tool data showing the tax data from the original tax return
guidetextdraw_179168.name: textdraw_1791682181650611312437

guidetextdraw_1803803789._value: Any letter or notice from the IRS indicating the changes the IRS made to the tax return data items, OR
guidetextdraw_1803803789.name: textdraw_18038037891656674869574

guidetextdraw_1189416798._value: A Tax Account Transcript, which shows any amended tax data items, OR
guidetextdraw_1189416798.name: textdraw_11894167981656674933625

guidetextdraw_1784217589._value: An IRS Record of Account Transcript, which shows the original tax return information and any changes that were made to it.
guidetextdraw_1784217589.name: textdraw_17842175891656674976662
